title: Syrian Arab Republic · Protection and Human Rights · 2025-11-18 – 2026-11-18
findings: Since December 2024, Syria has experienced a gradual shift from acute displacement toward large-scale returns, with more than 1.8 million refugees and two million internally displaced persons (IDPs) returning to their areas of origin [1].

During the April to June 2026 monitoring round, which consolidated 5,094 key informant interviews (KIIs) conducted by 48 partners across 756 communities and 175 sub-districts in all 14 governorates, data collection was heavily concentrated in Aleppo (34 per cent of KIIs), Idleb (26 per cent), and Ar-Raqqa (13 per cent) [3].
